# Chalet Bambi Sörenberg

## About
Chalet Bambi is a family holiday home in Sörenberg, Switzerland, located in the heart of the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve Entlebuch at 1,165 m above sea level. Built in 1972 by Max and Mary Staub, the chalet has been lovingly maintained by three generations of the Staub family. It was extensively renovated in 2018 while preserving its original alpine character.

## Property Details
- **Address:** Rothornstrasse 40, 6174 Sörenberg, Switzerland
- **Capacity:** Up to 4 guests (bedroom with 4 bunk beds, plus a sofa bed in the living room)
- **Features:** Wooden interior, fully equipped kitchen, 20 m² south-facing sun terrace, 650 m² garden directly on the Waldemme stream, fire bowl and outdoor fireplace, 2 parking spaces. No Wi-Fi.
- **Setting:** UNESCO Biosphere Entlebuch, at the foot of Brienzer Rothorn

## Location
Sörenberg is a mountain village in the Entlebuch region of Canton Lucerne. The surrounding UNESCO Biosphere is a unique mosaic of moorlands, alpine meadows, and forests. Brienzer Rothorn (2,350 m) is reached from Sörenberg by cable car (about 7 minutes, summer and winter); the historic steam cog railway runs on the Brienz side from June to October.

## Activities
- **Winter:** Skiing and snowboarding at Sörenberg ski area, cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, sledging, ice skating
- **Summer:** Hiking, cycling, Mooraculum bog adventure park at Rossweid, Rischli summer toboggan run, Brienzer Rothorn
- **Year-round:** UNESCO Biosphere excursions, nature walks, local gastronomy
